# seerr_watchlist (Resource)

Manage media watchlist items in Seerr.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `media_type` (String) Media type (`movie` or `tv`).
- `tmdb_id` (Number) The TMDB numeric ID of the movie or TV show.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (format: `tmdb_id:media_type`).
- `overview` (String) Summary/overview of the media item.
- `title` (String) Title of the media item.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# In Terraform 1.5.0 and later, use an import block to import seerr_watchlist. For example:
#
# import {
#   to = seerr_watchlist.example
#   id = "1"
# }

# The watchlist item ID.
# Otherwise, use the terraform import command:
terraform import seerr_watchlist.example 1
```
